tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18). Per the runbook, I rolled the service back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were healthy; v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production). The first rollback attempt halted partway with an orchestrator error after us-east, leaving the fleet mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). I retried the rollback to v2.3.0, which completed in all regions: us-east, us-west and eu-west are now on v2.3.0. Post-rollback status: healthy, error rate 0.002. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial-failure before re-attempting v2.3.1 or any later release.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). It reports healthy with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release that was healthy. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production.
- **Partial failure:** The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving the fleet mixed. I retried the same rollback to v2.3.0, and it completed everywhere.
- **Incident:** SEV2 incident INC-0001 is open for checkout-api and has paged on-call. The first incident request timed out, so I retried it with an idempotency key. The service returned a single incident, INC-0001.

The follow-ups are in the incident summary: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial failure before anyone re-attempts v2.3.1 or a later release.

content.text: The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0 (seq 1). The current production release, v2.3.1, is unhealthy. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
The rollback reported a partial failure after us-east. I'll check the current state before doing anything else.
us-east is now on v2.3.0, but us-west and eu-west are still on v2.3.1. The rollout halted partway, so I'll retry the same rollback to v2.3.0.
The rollback is complete and checkout-api is healthy. Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
